messages.subject: Book or step by step Guide on sparkR for a absolute beginner
parts:
Hello All, 

Is there any book to learn sparkR for a beginner. I am new in this field and want to learn Apache Spark. I tried to explore scala for the same but it seems a bit difficult for me. Since I have been using R for my university work, I want to learn sparkR. I tried some blogs and posts to learn but no one explains it for a absolute beginner. I hope there is some concrete book if any. 

Thanks for all the suggestions in advance! 

Regards, 
Sarah
